If you want to set time limits for certain apps, Digital Wellbeing feature of Android can help you do it. Please search for Digital Wellbeing in your phone settings and enable it.
To show/hide your screen time on the home screen, please allow or disallow the app usage permission. \n\nNote: No app usage data is collected. Everything is processed on your device.

Password must be at least 4 characters

If you forget your lockdown password, you may permanently lose access to certain phone functions unless JLauncher is removed via Settings, Play Store, or ADB.

Please consider enabling Password Recovery before setting a password.

Are you sure you want to proceed?
Tap the \'Password Recovery\' header 500 times without leaving the settings screen or turning off the screen. Your password will then be displayed.
Set a personal clue when you enable this option. You can view the clue at any time to help you remember your password.
Write a 500 character essay on why you want your password retrieved. No copy/paste allowed. After submission, your password will be displayed.
Pay a fee to retrieve your password. Choose an amount when enabling this option.
